rows.note: Army sources describe an integrated command-and-control suite, common data layer, target processing, and human soldier and commander responsibility in training.
rows.next: Acquire target and sensor lineage, confidence states, human action timestamps, command authority, aborts, and operational rules.
rows.fals: Exercise records show the stack did not materially inform the target-to-effect workflow.

rows.note: Official sources connect soldier feedback and operational data to requirement updates, baseline selection, procurement, and scaling.
rows.next: Acquire every capability-need version, acceptance threshold, data-quality rule, confidence definition, rejected change, and decision memo.
rows.fals: Version history shows feedback did not materially alter thresholds or baseline selection.

rows.note: No source-bounded case file joins a disputed input to an erroneous training or operational effect and later review.
rows.next: Acquire incident, near-miss, abort, safety, investigation, correction, responsibility, and after-action records.
rows.fals: Complete records show a clear ex ante burden, robust abort authority, and effective correction before effect.

rows.note: The Army states that tools do not replace soldiers, while reporting faster target identification and processing.
rows.ceil: human control stated, practical timing unresolved
rows.next: Acquire UI, alert, latency, confidence, approval, override, abort, and after-action timing records.
rows.fals: Operators had no meaningful opportunity to inspect or reject the relevant output.

rows.note: The official role map demonstrates multi-company integration; no complete custody and versioning matrix is public.
rows.next: Acquire the authoritative data lineage, log ownership, retention, access, interface-control, version, and discovery matrix.
rows.fals: The Army independently preserves the complete end-to-end record in a portable and auditable form.

rows.note: The Army documented a separate competitive award and different full-stack implementation leads.
rows.next: Acquire proposal denominator, component choices, evaluation, performance, switching, and common-baseline competition records.
rows.fals: The apparent competition was nominal and later decisions eliminated practical alternatives without testing.

rows.note: Official sources show continuous onboarding and baseline management without exposing the complete exception register.
rows.ceil: baseline and operational exception privilege unresolved
rows.next: Acquire waiver, deviation, security exception, change-control, urgent-fielding, and nonconformance records.
rows.fals: No material exceptions existed or every exception received independent review and transparent disposition.

rows.note: The feedback loop is documented at program level, while error distribution and private residual benefit are not.
rows.ceil: operational learning with unresolved error and benefit allocation
rows.next: Acquire defects, failures, aborted missions, remediation, compensation, vendor changes, payments, IP, and standards outcomes.
rows.fals: Learning and benefit were broadly shared while errors were corrected before consequential use.
